# Task: 2-line review delta on YOUR PR #6988 (in-PR, before merge)

You are agy. The cross-family review (PASS, posted on the PR) found one residual of the same
hazard class your PR fixes: `scripts/fleet_comms/review_publisher.py` lines ~415 and ~496
(`ensure_job_row_for_receipt`, `publish_sealed_verdict`) still call `apply_migrations(...)`
directly on a borrowed connection. Reviewer verified these are REDUNDANT (ArtifactStore runs
apply_migrations at construction, artifacts.py:98) and currently harmless (no caller holds an
open write transaction) — but a future in-transaction caller would be bitten.

## Steps
1. In your existing worktree `.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6987-flaky-race` (branch
   `agy/infra-6987-flaky-race`): remove those two direct apply_migrations calls (and any
   now-unused import), preserving the documented do-not-close semantics.
2. Run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_fleet_comms_authority_cutover.py
   tests/test_fleet_comms_routing_reservations.py tests/test_fleet_comms_review_publication.py -q`
   and ruff on the touched file. Quote output.
3. Push to the SAME branch (updates PR #6988). NO auto-merge.
